requirements.text: Fable return / switch-back: the system must know when Fable normally returns (weekly cap lift, normally Thursday 9 PM local), check whether it is back, and switch back to Fable. SATISFACTION BINDING (verified against the certified controller, loop.py D-004-R751/R754/R758 block): the built chain already returns to the pinned model (claude-fable-5) at the next seam it is available, availability decided by an ACTUAL LAUNCH PROBE - strictly stronger than a clock guess; the Thursday-9PM knowledge additionally lands as (a) the recorded resume_not_before_utc deadline whenever a run stops on the weekly limit (drives the wake task), and (b) an owner-ordered weekly Thursday 21:00 local scheduled task running the controller's fixed --recover-boot action, so a fully-capped night still gets a Thursday-evening recovery attempt with no session alive.
requirements.required_evidence: model_selection.toml chain entry + journal substitution/return events; the weekly scheduled task present with the fixed manifest-verified action

requirements.text: Fallback trigger and target: go to claude-opus-4-8 (xhigh) for the main agent ONLY when the week's Fable quota is exhausted. SATISFACTION BINDING: worker chain = fallback_models[claude-opus-4-8] in model_selection.toml (claude-opus-4-8 already on the immutable config.toml allowlist); the certified chain steps down ONLY on reason_code quota_exhausted (any other failure keeps the fail-closed pause) and records the substitution as a first-class event - exactly the only-on-weekly-exhaustion condition. The xhigh element binds at the layers where effort is lawfully configurable (session /model + agent-file conventions per D-004 and the standing 2026-08-05 reviewer-fallback rule: Fable -> claude-opus-4-8 xhigh); the PERMANENT D-004-R159 prohibition stands - the supervisor never writes or passes an effort key (sole standing exception: codex.review_reasoning_effort per M0-T146).
requirements.required_evidence: model_selection.toml diff; config.toml allowlist unchanged; substitution events carry quota_exhausted only

requirements.text: Autostart with timed retry: autostart must know what time the limit lifts and, if Claude Code is late to reopen, retry every 4 minutes up to 50 times until the loop is running. SATISFACTION BINDING: install the controller-planned OS tasks (owner-approved setup act, D-007 S11.4; this directive IS the owner approval): the boot task (logon trigger) now, the per-deadline wake task (TimeTrigger at the recorded resume_not_before_utc, WakeToRun, StartWhenAvailable) whenever a run stops on a limit, and the weekly Thursday task of R001; each carries the owner-ordered Task Scheduler restart policy RestartOnFailure Interval=PT4M Count=50 added AFTER certified installation via Set-ScheduledTask - the fixed, manifest-verified action and launcher are never altered (the S11.4 security property), only the OS retry setting the owner ordered. DURABLE FOLLOW-UP (freeze lane): controller-side XML support for the restart policy so the digest covers it, to be contracted as a supervisor task.
requirements.required_evidence: schtasks/Get-ScheduledTask output showing the tasks, their fixed actions, and the PT4M/50 restart policy; installation transcript in the D-035 overnight/day report
